children.value: **Purpose**: The STRATUM Kernel is the irreducible core of the specification—the minimum set of definitions required for K0 conformance. This section provides a self-contained reading guide for implementers who need only the essential framework without certification, concurrency, or advanced features.

**Conformance Level K0 (Kernel-Conformant)**: Implementers reading ONLY the Kernel sections can achieve basic STRATUM conformance. Higher conformance levels (K1: Certified-Aware, K2: Regulated-Pipeline, K3: Live-Graph) require additional sections per referenceMap("sub-sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT-4", "§{{sectionNumber}}.4 Structure Overview").
The Kernel consists of six essential subsystems:

attributes.term: **1. Data Structures** (referenceMap("sub-xYOy8xUJpcssgjNVmANNW", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Element") – referenceMap("sub-1PQdtQJCcUP4hsmjE7iJL", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Layer") – referenceMap("sub-przG8f9oPcQ5oNMXdlyHX", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Dependency"))
attributes.statement: Element, Layer, Dependency — the core abstract syntax tree. Read: Definition 2.1 (Element), Definition 2.6 (Layer), Definition 2.11 (Dependency), Definition 2.8 (DEPTYPE enumeration).
QF_LIA + QF_LRA + QF_UF constraint language. Read: Definition 2.12 (Predicate Language), Definition 2.16 (Constraint), Theorem 2.1 (Decidability). Note: SMT-LIB 2.6 standard required for conformance.
Structural invariants that all specifications must satisfy. Read: All WF-rules including WF-ID, WF-LAYER, WF-ACYCLIC-HARD, WF-SOFT-CYCLE-BOUNDED, WF-CASCADE-TERMINATION (added v2.4.4).

attributes.term: **4. Six Guarantees** (referenceMap("sub-2rVTmZOx_FfwEKLswk1-j", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Traceability") – referenceMap("sub-K1-qOmCVrnDqLrLgOd_aa", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Completeness") – referenceMap("sub-sbASI3HUkg21rQji8CA3y", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Consistency") – referenceMap("sub-PNmArYZo6xNqQZsWMEHGT", "§{{sectionNumber}}.4 Groundedness") – referenceMap("sub-XWHt4rvXeJPsjryeyJk-f", "§{{sectionNumber}}.5 Determinism") – referenceMap("sub-BY56RlNT5fC29dbs7WShu", "§{{sectionNumber}}.6 Coherence"))
attributes.statement: G1 (Traceability), G2 (Completeness), G3 (Consistency), G4 (Groundedness), G5 (Determinism), G6 (Coherence). These are the semantic properties that define a Valid specification. G7 (Explainability) is K1, not K0.
Cascade computation (CASCADE-1, CASCADE-N, CASCADE-ATT), constraint satisfaction (CONSTR-SAT), trace computation (TRACE-ROOT, TRACE-STEP). These define the operational semantics.

attributes.term: **6. Core Operations** (referenceMap("sub-amKfbMudBf4a5EIxM14St", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Query Operations") – referenceMap("sub-9q6VwEYOZyqBvxep8Dw5x", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Modification Operations") – referenceMap("sub-doChtsVucb4PgzoofGPjB", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Comparison Operations"))
attributes.statement: validate(S) → violations, trace(e) → path, impact(S, δ) → affected elements. These are the three required Kernel operations. Note: validateIncremental (referenceMap("sub-amKfbMudBf4a5EIxM14St", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Query Operations").1) is K3, not K0.

children.value: All Kernel operations share three essential properties:

attributes.statement: All Kernel functions are deterministic total functions with no side effects. No I/O, no randomness, no wall-clock time dependencies. Given the same input, always produce the same output.

All Kernel judgments terminate with definite yes/no answers. No "unknown" or "timeout" results. Well-formedness checking is O(|E| + |D| + |L|²). Constraint validation is decidable via SMT solving (NP-complete, but terminates).

Kernel(S₁ ⊕ S₂) = Kernel(S₁) ⊕ Kernel(S₂). Merging two specifications preserves all Kernel properties. This follows from the CRDT-based merge semantics (referenceMap("sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT", "§{{sectionNumber}}")) but does not require understanding CRDTs for K0 conformance.

attributes.title: What is NOT in the Kernel

children.value: The following features are EXTENSIONS, not Kernel requirements:

**Concurrency (referenceMap("sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-aAgCXhEN9t0xxoeTpf0Qc", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: CRDTs, vector clocks, conflict resolution. Optional for single-user tools.

**Certification (referenceMap("sec-5jP_ZWlaA8SfDbhVxrG99", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-YFHOeAjN2dYDjDiTocSSI", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-z3nlCPJ5B1h7TUhEf25LL", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-S3Z17-kDEc2A9A92Y0bqi", "§{{sectionNumber}}"), referenceMap("sec-ZBsFkK5bvDEL4m-rsfH17", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-RBDT59WZE2xJyi9k5UFvY", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-rRDDwm1LZy_CFk7nC2L0k", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-Nei3FTlw11oOPZVBq920l", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-x6eVbGvoVfS9GNeqNkLUG", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-dM0e66FHuNRBmoEaMjfxF", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-F4EMqD3954zBnfEDnmQGj", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: RTM, DO-178C/ISO 26262 mappings, STPA/FMEA. Only required for K2+ conformance.

**Advanced Operations (referenceMap("sec-aBNKnM08R3W5pfjELaQas", "§{{sectionNumber}}"), referenceMap("sec-FzfSSWJ73nYlWnpzz3-B7", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-xEbsOCjQmAy1Uj_H6qRLr", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: Artifact adapters, domain profiles, extension mechanisms. Useful but not essential.

**Mechanized Proofs (referenceMap("sec-z3nlCPJ5B1h7TUhEf25LL", "§{{sectionNumber}}"), referenceMap("sec-PAskKN4i1etyZhtOY5xtv", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-ojM0_ZLauOdjNuKK99Pg0", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-dIOSpm6loMFLin3AzkYRN", "§{{sectionNumber}}") – referenceMap("sec-LUj58UniUYiDJ-BI2QMU3", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))**: TLA+, Coq, Lean templates. Helpful for verification but not required for implementation.
**G7 Explainability (referenceMap("sub-Q_FIkGVXUuZIl6JAWPVwl", "§{{sectionNumber}}.8 Valid Specification"))**: Unsat core generation. This is K1 (Certified-Aware), not K0.
For K0 conformance, read in this order:

referenceMap("sub-sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT-1", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Core Contributions") – referenceMap("sub-sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT-2", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Key Theorems") – referenceMap("sub-sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT-3", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Certification Path"): Primitive sets, notation (5 minutes)
referenceMap("sub-sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT-4", "§{{sectionNumber}}.4 Structure Overview"): This section (10 minutes)

referenceMap("sub-xYOy8xUJpcssgjNVmANNW", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Element") – referenceMap("sub-1PQdtQJCcUP4hsmjE7iJL", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Layer") – referenceMap("sub-przG8f9oPcQ5oNMXdlyHX", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Dependency") – referenceMap("sub-CyAf_GsK2z3HhpvlCgKlD", "§{{sectionNumber}}.4 Constraint"): Element, Layer, Dependency, Constraint (30 minutes)
referenceMap("sec-pYrht_aqaJ5gENPPS98r-", "§{{sectionNumber}}"): Well-formedness conditions (15 minutes)

referenceMap("sub-2rVTmZOx_FfwEKLswk1-j", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Traceability") – referenceMap("sub-K1-qOmCVrnDqLrLgOd_aa", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Completeness") – referenceMap("sub-sbASI3HUkg21rQji8CA3y", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Consistency") – referenceMap("sub-PNmArYZo6xNqQZsWMEHGT", "§{{sectionNumber}}.4 Groundedness") – referenceMap("sub-XWHt4rvXeJPsjryeyJk-f", "§{{sectionNumber}}.5 Determinism") – referenceMap("sub-BY56RlNT5fC29dbs7WShu", "§{{sectionNumber}}.6 Coherence"): The Six Guarantees G1-G6 (25 minutes)
referenceMap("sec-CwnDzo78GYBw57r1EI_R5", "§{{sectionNumber}}"): Inference rules for cascade, trace, constraints (20 minutes)

referenceMap("sub-amKfbMudBf4a5EIxM14St", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Query Operations") – referenceMap("sub-9q6VwEYOZyqBvxep8Dw5x", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Modification Operations") – referenceMap("sub-doChtsVucb4PgzoofGPjB", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Comparison Operations"): validate(), trace(), impact() operations (15 minutes)

referenceMap("sub-OBU4duRRllB7_9IhbL-1N", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Soundness") – referenceMap("sub-OB_3VjaM4yzhjgIYWx1_k", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Convergence") – referenceMap("sub-kbjoG8RVDTc33BlKjcHtq", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Decidability"): Soundness, decidability, cascade termination theorems (10 minutes)
**Total: ~2 hours** to understand the complete Kernel. Compare this to 30 sections (8-10 hours for full specification).

**Kernel Boundary Enforcement**: Some sections are explicitly marked **non-Kernel**. Artifact Adapters (referenceMap("sec-xEbsOCjQmAy1Uj_H6qRLr", "§{{sectionNumber}}")) introduce `effectful: true` to mark I/O-performing components that violate Kernel purity. These adapters emit Operation lists that the Kernel consumes deterministically, maintaining the pure/effectful boundary.
To claim K0 conformance, your implementation must:
✓ Implement data structures: Specification, Element, Layer, Dependency, Constraint, Binding, CascadeRule
✓ Implement constraint language: QF_LIA + QF_LRA + QF_UF (via SMT solver like Z3, CVC5, or Yices)
✓ Implement all WF-rules from referenceMap("sec-pYrht_aqaJ5gENPPS98r-", "§{{sectionNumber}}") (including additions: WF-SOFT-CYCLE-BOUNDED, WF-CASCADE-TERMINATION)

✓ Implement guarantee checkers for G1-G6 (referenceMap("sub-2rVTmZOx_FfwEKLswk1-j", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Traceability") – referenceMap("sub-K1-qOmCVrnDqLrLgOd_aa", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Completeness") – referenceMap("sub-sbASI3HUkg21rQji8CA3y", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Consistency") – referenceMap("sub-PNmArYZo6xNqQZsWMEHGT", "§{{sectionNumber}}.4 Groundedness") – referenceMap("sub-XWHt4rvXeJPsjryeyJk-f", "§{{sectionNumber}}.5 Determinism") – referenceMap("sub-BY56RlNT5fC29dbs7WShu", "§{{sectionNumber}}.6 Coherence"))
✓ Implement cascade computation per CASCADE-1, CASCADE-N rules (referenceMap("sub-5Xu8Vv_BHhTdzfCjtqDRo", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Cascade Computation"))

✓ Implement validate(S), trace(e), impact(S, δ) operations (referenceMap("sub-amKfbMudBf4a5EIxM14St", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Query Operations") – referenceMap("sub-9q6VwEYOZyqBvxep8Dw5x", "§{{sectionNumber}}.2 Modification Operations") – referenceMap("sub-doChtsVucb4PgzoofGPjB", "§{{sectionNumber}}.3 Comparison Operations"))
✓ Pass Kernel test suite (if available from reference implementation)
✓ Demonstrate purity: All operations return same output for same input
✓ Demonstrate decidability: All operations terminate (no infinite loops)

**Optional but Recommended**: Implement Zod schemas (referenceMap("sec-TmlplXlhpu2gAP4_iKrgd", "§{{sectionNumber}}")) for runtime validation, though note the schema drift warning from v2.4.4 (Zod schemas are v1.0 and lack v2.0+ fields like cascade_boundary, priority, actor, clock).
